text:
Dana (Customer): hey, hitting a weird permissions gap after we renamed a group in Okta, a few folks lost admin in our Redwood org during a deploy window :confused:
Aisha (CSE): ugh, sorry to hear that — can you paste the SCIM event logs or a sample payload?
Dana (Customer): sure — looks like okta sent a PATCH then a subsequent PUT for the renamed group. most responses were 200. but affected users show role removed in our UI.
Dana (Customer): sample snippet from our Okta syslog:
```
2026-02-25T14:02:11Z PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/00g12345
Request: {"displayName":"engineering-admins"} 
Response: 200 OK
2026-02-25T14:02:12Z PUT /scim/v2/Groups/00g12345
Request: {"displayName":"eng-admins"} 
Response: 200 OK
```
Aisha (CSE): thanks. did you change the Group-to-Role mapping in Redwood Console at the same time? or was that mapping configured to match displayName?
Dana (Customer): mapping was by displayName (we inherited the config from onboarding). we renamed group in Okta but didn't update the mapping first. expected that redwood would match by id though?
Ben (Eng): quick note — current mapping logic in the product prioritizes exact displayName match first, then group id. this was a deliberate backward-compatible choice but it makes renames racy.
Carlos (IAM-bot): automated log from provisioning service: 
"2026-02-25T14:02:13Z scim: group-update received id=00g12345 oldDisplayName=engineering-admins newDisplayName=eng-admins mappingMatch=old_name_applied usersEvaluated=86 rolesRemoved=12 rolesAdded=0"
Dana (Customer): so why did roles get removed? we expected either preserved or migrated to the new name mapping.
Ben (Eng): because the UI-mapping was keyed to the literal displayName 'engineering-admins'. sequence was: Okta PATCH (old->new), SCIM event processed, our sync looked up mapping against current displayName in mapping table and didn't find 'eng-admins' so it treated change as group removed + new group created, which triggered deprovision of roles tied to the old mapping.
Aisha (CSE): do we have repro steps we can share with Redwoods' team? customer is asking for root cause and whether we can restore roles.
Ben (Eng): repro steps (internal):
1) create SCIM group with displayName 'temp-admins' mapped to role 'org-admin' in Console
2) add users to group
3) from IdP rename displayName -> 'tmp-admins' (same group id)
4) watch provisioning logs — if mapping keyed to displayName, users will briefly lose role before manual remap

Ben (Eng): quick workaround: update mapping to reference the group's SCIM id (00g12345) instead of displayName OR create a temporary mapping for the new displayName before renaming at IdP.
Dana (Customer): we did the temporary remap after noticing the issue, but ~12 users had their admin removed and are blocked on a couple of urgent tasks. can you restore their roles?
Aisha (CSE): we can script a reconciliation — would need list of affected emails or user IDs and the role to reapply. can you DM that? (please redact PII in public thread) :lock_with_ink_pen:
Dana (Customer): sending DM now.
Carlos (IAM-bot): reconcile endpoint available: `POST /admin/scim/reconcile` (internal only). sample payload: 
```json
{
  "group_id": "00g12345",
  "target_role": "org-admin",
  "users": ["dana@example.com", "user2@acme.com"]
}
```
Ben (Eng): i've scheduled a short patch: change mapping precedence to prefer group id when available, and add a short transactional window where displayName changes are treated as rename rather than delete+create. estimate: 3-4 hrs dev + canary.
Aisha (CSE): can you also add a visible warning in Console when a mapping uses displayName (legacy)? we should surface that to prevent future renames causing outages.
Ben (Eng): yes. i'll file a PR to change precedence and add telemetry. will also add an audit event `group_mapping_mismatch` that includes old/new displayNames and mappingKeyUsed.
Dana (Customer): after your workaround we restored 10/12 users but two still don't have admin. any insight?
Carlos (IAM-bot): logs for those two show: `user lookup failed: externalIdentity not found` — likely they were removed from IdP and re-added during rename which created a new external identity id.
Aisha (CSE): if their externalIdentity changed, we need the customer's IdP to assert stable externalIds for users or we can map via email during reconcile. which would you prefer?
Dana (Customer): prefer email-based restore for those two — i'll provide addresses in DM.
Ben (Eng): noted. for the long term we should: 
- require id-based mapping in Console (migration path)
- add a 'preview remap' tool that simulates the effect of a rename and lists affected users
- add a reconcile api to undo accidental deprovisioning with audit trail

incidents-bot: created incident INC-2026-042: SCIM rename -> transient admin removals (severity: low-medium) assigned to eng/scim
Aisha (CSE): updating internal KB: include steps for customers doing group renames and mention the two quick fixes (map to id, create new mapping before rename).
Dana (Customer): thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround. one ask: can you add a console banner that warns 'you are using displayName mapping' so our SREs don't rename unknowingly?
Ben (Eng): will add banner and a one-click migrate-to-id button. i'll post the PR link when available.
Aisha (CSE): update — ran reconcile for provided users, verified 12 users restored, 2 needed manual email-based mapping which Dana confirmed. closing loop on customer side.
Dana (Customer): confirmed — all good now. thanks everyone :trophy: 
Ben (Eng): followups:
- PR #4023 (mapping precedence + telemetry) opened, tests included
- UX ticket UX-1177 for banner + migrate button
- ops runbook updated with reconcile steps and sample `POST /admin/scim/reconcile` payloads
Carlos (IAM-bot): note: add metric scim.mapping.renames.count and scim.mapping.renames.impact_users to help catch this earlier.
Aisha (CSE): marking this thread as resolved for customer; we'll keep engineering tickets open until changes are deployed.
Dana (Customer): thanks again, appreciate clear steps and the reconcile script.
